title: Selected milestones
description: A selection of formative moments, turning points and achievements that trace Ryan Laird's path from backyard astronomy to science communication, space-sector strategy and initiative building.

items.title: A comet makes space feel close
items.summary: Seeing Comet Hale–Bopp as a child was an early reminder that the night sky is not an abstract subject: it is visible, changing and capable of provoking lifelong curiosity.
items.achievement: An early spark for an enduring interest in astronomy

items.title: The eclipse that made astronomy immediate
items.summary: The 1999 solar eclipse made an astronomical event a shared national experience. It strengthened an interest in observing the sky and in the way science can bring people together around a moment of wonder.
items.achievement: A formative experience of astronomy as public engagement

items.title: Backyard astronomy begins
items.summary: Started observing from home at around age thirteen, turning curiosity into a regular practice of learning the sky, following celestial events and asking more ambitious questions.
items.achievement: Moved from interest to sustained self-directed learning

items.title: School years and a growing astronomy community
items.company: School education and Horncastle Astronomy Weekend
items.summary: Developed a scientific foundation at school while attending Horncastle Astronomy Weekend from 2003, finding a community around practical astronomy, shared knowledge and enthusiasm for the night sky.
items.achievement: Found the value of astronomy as a shared community practice

items.title: Rare events turn curiosity into direction
items.summary: Witnessing the 2003 solar eclipse, the 2003 transit of Mercury and the 2004 transit of Venus made orbital mechanics tangible and reinforced a decision to pursue physics and astrophysics.
items.achievement: Astronomy became an academic direction, not only a personal interest

items.title: Physics and astrophysics
items.summary: Studied Physics with Astrophysics, developing a foundation in mathematics, quantitative research, scientific writing and the careful handling of evidence and uncertainty.
items.achievement: Completed an MPhys (Hons) in Physics with Astrophysics

items.title: Astronomy becomes a public mission
items.company: International Year of Astronomy and Royal Astronomical Society
items.summary: Contributed to the International Year of Astronomy as UK Student Representative, connecting astronomy with education, outreach and public participation at a moment of global celebration.
items.achievement: UK Student Representative for International Year of Astronomy 2009

items.title: Research, observation and science outreach
items.company: Doctoral studies, astronomy research and outreach
items.summary: Undertook doctoral studies in astronomy while extending research and outreach experience. This period included observing-time awards as co-investigator with the European Southern Observatory and Palomar Observatory, alongside a Royal Astronomical Society Education and Outreach Small Grant.
items.achievement: Combined research participation with practical science communication

items.title: A global perspective on space
items.summary: Attended the Space Studies Programme on a UK Space Agency and European Space Agency scholarship. Contributed to AMBIEnT, a project exploring affordable microsatellite-enabled connectivity and environmental monitoring.
items.achievement: UK Space Agency and European Space Agency scholarship recipient

items.title: Communication, innovation and entrepreneurship
items.company: Design & Data, R&R Space and sector initiatives
items.summary: Developed digital storytelling and event communications for space-sector organisations, then co-founded a space outreach and skills venture. The period brought together content, community building, entrepreneurship and innovation activity.
items.achievement: Award of Excellence, The Communicator Awards; ESA BIC Startup Challenge winner; invited UK Space Conference panellist

items.title: From space innovation to responsible systems
items.company: ESA Business Applications, Green Orbit Digital and Impact Orbit
items.summary: Led communications and digital marketing for ESA Business Applications through HE Space, then founded Green Orbit Digital. Current work combines strategy, science communication, sustainability and collaborative initiatives including Leicester Space Week.
items.achievement: Founder-led work connecting space, sustainability, communication and public value
